en.name: Celestine II
en.summary: A pope, formerly a student of the theologian Peter Abelard, whose reign of less than six months focused on continuing recent reform efforts.
en.body: Celestine II, who had studied under the controversial theologian Peter Abelard and had once been excommunicated alongside him before reconciling with the church, held office only briefly. His short reign continued the reform and diplomatic initiatives of his immediate predecessors with little independent major action recorded.
